main_text.p: II.[Observatio. Accusativus cujuscunq; numeri, etiam natura longus, tantùm acuitur.]
main_text.head: De usu Articuli.
main_text.p: III.Præterquàm ad dignoscendum genus, utimur etiam Articulo:
1. In exponendo seu declarando, ut: Δεινότης ἡ ὀν τοῖς λόγοις. Τὰς ἡδονὰς ἡρᾶς τὰς μεγάλας δόξης.
2. In distinguendo vel discernendo, ut: Αἴας ὁ Τελαμώνιος. Τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἄγιον.
3. In demonstrandâ re certâ aut excellente, ut: ὁ Σωφρήτης ἐι οὐ; Πέρας ἄπασιν ἀνθρώποις ἐπὶ βίῳ ὁ θάνατος.
[Et hoc modo Articulus τὸ præponitur quibuslibet dictionibus, τεχνικῶς seu materialiter acceptis. ut: ὁ ἄνθρωπος, τὸ λέγω, τὸ καλῶς, τὸ λαβὲ βιῶσαι.]
4. In dividendo seu distribuendo, additis Conjunctionibus μὲν & δὲ: idq; per omnes casus. ut: Ἀνθρώποι οἱ μὲν ἡδὺ, οἱ δὲ παρεσκευάζοντο.

page.notes: Greek text is partly worn and several Greek words are uncertain; the accents and breathings in the Greek examples are approximate. The line "Τῶν" at the foot is a catchword-like fragment, left in the text. The marginal section numbers are reproduced as in the printed page.
